entities.name: Dev
entities.rationale: Developer pushing source code changes to the repository.

entities.name: CODECOMMIT
entities.rationale: AWS CodeCommit source control repository storing application code.

entities.name: CODEBUILD
entities.rationale: AWS CodeBuild service compiling source code, running tests, and producing artifacts.

entities.name: REGISTRY
entities.rationale: Amazon ECR (Container Registry) storing built container images.

entities.name: CLOUDFORMATION
entities.rationale: AWS CloudFormation provisioning infrastructure using ChangeSets (1. ChangeSet, 2. Approve, 3. Execute).

entities.name: VPC
entities.rationale: Virtual Private Cloud enclosing target application infrastructure components.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Amazon ECS cluster deployed within the VPC running containerized applications.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: AWS Identity and Access Management managing security roles and permissions within the VPC boundary.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Application Load Balancer distributing incoming traffic across ECS containers.

visual_connections.description: Developer pushes source code commits to AWS CodeCommit.
CodeCommit triggers the AWS CodeBuild build stage.
CodeBuild pushes compiled container images to Amazon ECR (REGISTRY).
CloudFormation deploys and updates infrastructure components (ECS, IAM, ALB) inside the VPC.
